programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP04 A Great Detective Comes to Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP05 Scarlet Seduction [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP06 Black Star [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Sadohara thinks that by making the Ishiyama students do their own physical examinations that they're sure to cause trouble, which would be enough to get them all expelled! But when Furuichi and Oga end up hiding under a desk while the girls get changed, they've got trouble of a whole other kind...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Raising Baby Beel isn't getting any easier, and Oga is determined once again to find someone to dump him off on. Oga thinks maybe it takes more than brawn to attract Baby Beel, and starts to search for someone with brains, too! At the same time, rumors of a secret school group made of elite athletes whose job it is to enforce the school's moral code start going around, and members of Ishiyama's special class stop showing up to school... Who exactly are these 6 Holy Knights?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi go off in search of the rest of the 6 Holy Nights, but meanwhile Shiroyama is being picked on by some of St. Ishiyama's students, who know he can't fight back or risk getting expelled. It doesn't take long for the 6 Holy Knights to call out all of Ishiyama to the roof for a real showdown!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: While trying to retrieve the 7th Chaos Emerald from Dr. Eggman, Sonic and Friends are transported to the human world where Sonic is rescued by a boy named Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic discovers that Cream and Cheese are being held captive by the military. Sonic, with the help of Chris and his grandfather Chuck, finds and frees them only to be caught in a trap!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Eggman tries to use E-23 to take over the world Amy, Knuckles and Tails launch an unsuccessful counterattack, until Sonic arrives! And with a ring from Tails, Sonic destroys E-23 and saves Amy with the help of Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris' teacher has been replaced with the President's spy, Mr. Stewart. Meanwhile, the first Chaos Emerald appears at a construction site. It's then a race to the stone between Eggman and Sonic!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman tricks Knuckles into blaming Sonic for being stuck in the human world, Knuckles challenges Sonic to a duel! But Knuckles realizes he's being duped and teams up with Sonic to destroy the robot and save the others.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP80 The Last Gift in Prison is Cup Ramen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Silver, who once worked with Lupin on a train robbery, stole the money himself, hid it somewhere, and promptly got himself thrown into prison on a rinky-dink charge. Lupin, having learned that Silver is about to be released, goes to the prison intent on making Silver tell what he did with the loot, only to discover that, while Silver was in prison, a new top-of-the-line prison was built over the site where he hid the money. Now, will the operation to trade an execution for the recovery of the money succeed?!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP81 Fujiko, Men are A Sorry Lot! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin is after the Golden Bell, symbol of the monarchy of Beltenberg and precious tourist attraction. However, the bell that sparkles in the belfry is just a brass replica. Though Fujiko insists that the bell made of gold doesn't exist, Lupin believes to the contrary. Meanwhile, Lupin gets news of Fujiko's engagement to prince Claude of Beltenberg, whom she had met in Paris.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP82 Hostage Rescue Operation: Pops [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Zenigata is taken hostage from ICPO headquarters. The terrorists demand to swap him with their boss Napoleon XI, but ICPO refuses. Since Zenigata is no further use to them, the terrorists are bound to kill him; Lupin must now come to his rescue but do it delicately so as to not hurt Zenigata's pride. Thus, begins Lupin's Zenigata-rescue caper ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP83 Lupin’s Big Western [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Smith Gang hit-man company was once the best in the business, but they're suffering now from tough competition. Though the company chairman Smith considers running TV ads to revive his business, he can't think of a good way to do it. Fujiko gets word that he's willing to shovel out 300 million dollars for a good idea, so they decide to film a Western in which Lupin gets killed ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP84 Leave the Revenge to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Though Joe Spade was once a formidable hitman of renown and Jigen's sharpshooter coach, he now comes to beg for Jigen's help; he had gotten old, flubbed a hit contract, and is now on the run. Jigen decides to help his old mentor and heads to Mareseilles with Lupin, but Lupin has a change of heart because he hates killers. So Jigen heads to Jigen's ramshakle shack all by himself ...

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: When Mr. Stewart drops by for a surprise visit, Chris and Chuck are barely able to keep Sonic and Friends' stay a secret and after Chris' uncle arrives, things get messier. Everyone, including Ella and Mr. Tanaka, are going to find out!

programme.desc: After Eggman discovers that he is being watched by the military he sends E-90 to swallow the satellite, but this disrupts everyone's TVs! So, Chuck and Tails decide to upgrade the Tornado into X-Tornado, allowing Sonic to enter high altitude in order to destroy E-90.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Chris, Amy, Cream and Cheese arrive at a resort, Eggman appears and tries to take over with his E-39 but Sonic arrives and tries to stop him. However Sonic is unable to swim, and the robot tries to drag him into the ocean!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: It's Team Sonic vs Team Eggman in a game of baseball for a Chaos Emerald! Team Sonic falls behind at first but then wins with a Sonic super-play, only to have Eggman to cheat and try to steal the Emerald regardless!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP85 The ICPO’s Secret Order [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: ICPO Bureau Chief Jasmine is an able commissioner. She uses the governor to spur Zenigata into action, as she has a secret plan to arrest Lupin. But Jasmine's plan is to make this mission her very last at ICPO so she could get married. Who is Jasmine marrying? Will her plan to arrest Lupin succeed?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP86 The Mysterious Nocturnal Mask [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Nocturnal Mask murdered the Duke of Le Mond and stole his diamonds. ICPO is having trouble solving the case, so they induct mystery author Conan Drill as a special inspector. Drill deduces that the true identity of Nocturnal Mask is Lupin. Learning that Count Johannes is his next target, he and Zenigata lie in wait at the Johannes Mansion, where a costume ball is taking place ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP87 When the Devil Calls to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In a night of thunder and rain, a man gives Lupin a doll. That very night Lupin has a nightmare of being manipulated by a man named Mephistopheles. The next day there is a news report that a diamond called the Phoenix Tear had been stolen. Though Lupin had been caught on security camera, he has no recollection of having done the deed. What is going on?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP88 Lupin's North Pole, South Pole Adventure [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E10 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the IMAX 3D surf film featuring Kelly Slater. The Ultimate Wave Tahiti follows a quest to find the perfect wave-riding experience. Filmed in Tahiti and the islands of French Polynesia.

programme.title: Terra Incognita
programme.desc: A tight New Zealand crew attempts to ski new lines in the unknown terrains of the Southern Alps.

programme.title: VITO

programme.title: The Captain & Casey Show
programme.desc: Oddball anchormen Jeff "The Captain" Carlson and Chris Casey share the latest news in the world of skateboarding in this on-the-cheap, bizarro broadcast designed to appeal to the sensibilities of today's young skaters. Set in what appears to be a wood-paneled basement, our two sick hosts discuss their favorite sport, with top dogs of the skateboard circuit dropping in for a visit. Posers like Mom and Dad might find these freewheeling goofballs a bit sketchy, but their teenage kids will be stoked.

programme.title: Catch Up With

programme.title: Camp Woodward
programme.desc: For most children, summer camp is a time of singing songs by the fire, creating gimp bracelets in arts and crafts, and munching on s'mores. For a special breed of camper, however, it's the season for practicing a 180 G-Turn or mastering a 50/50 grind. "Camp Woodward" follows young daredevils-in-training into the Pennsylvania Dutch countryside, where action-sports counselors and visiting guest professionals help turn these skateboarding and BMX students into the Tony Hawks and Ryan Nyquists of tomorrow.

programme.desc: Professional snowboarder Danny Kass, winner of two Olympic silver medals and even more Winter X Games bling, teams up with Australian colleague Luke "the Dingo" Trembath for a rollicking sports travel series. If there's fresh powder and a steep incline, chances are these two fun-loving guys and their entourage are speeding there in their customized RV, eagerly awaiting the chance to display their talents. While the emphasis is on snowboarding, the energetic hosts also dabble in any other extreme sport that may come their way, as well as the usual off-hour, juvenile high jinks.

And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africaâs diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo â a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote âBurn Campsâ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africaâs iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Inside Desertus Bikus Eng
programme.desc: Josh partcipates to Desertus Bikus, an ultra cycling race that crosses Spain and Portugal starting in Hasparren in the Basque Country and finishing in Setubal Portugal. Josh is cycling during 1400 km across desert areas, villages, gravel tracks and asphalt roads.

programme.title: Race to the Rock
programme.desc: The Race to the Rock is an annual unsupported ultra-distance bicycle race through the Australian Outback organized by Jesse Carlsson. Unlike stage races, such as the Tour De France, ultra-distance races start and run continuously until the competitors finish the race, forcing them to make such strategic choices as whether it would be better to take time to eat or sleep, or to sacrifice those things and press on. Race to the Rock is an unsupported race, which means that racers are not permitted to draft or to obtain help from anything other than publicly available sources that are available for all. The course varies every year, but finishes at Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, and has been so gruelling that only a very small percentage of the competitors have ever finished the race. Roads are mostly unsealed, with limited water supplies, and stretches of 400-500 kilometres at times with no food resupply available.

programme.title: Tour de France EFGH Singapore Criterium 2025
programme.desc: The Tour de France Singapore Criterium returns for its fourth edition, bringing the speed, strategy, and spectacle of elite cycling back to the streets of Marina Bay. Leading this yearâs line-up is Jasper Philipsen, to reclaim the Tour de France Singapore Criterium title he won in 2023, after being edged out last year by the legendary Mark Cavendish in his unforgettable farewell race.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australiaâs premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: Cro Race 2025
programme.desc: The 2025 CRO Race is a road cycling stage race (6 stages - 900 km) in Croatia held between 30 September and 5 October 2025. It is the tenth edition of the Tour of Croatia since its revival in 2015 and the sixth under the CRO Race name. The race is rated as a category 2.1 event on the 2025 UCI Europe Tour calendar

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film

It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng

The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series 2025 Season Recap - Unfinished Business Eng
programme.desc: This exclusive episode offers fans a fresh and emotional look back at the season, featuring the most thrilling moments, behind-the-scenes insights, and never-before-seen interviews with the athletes who defined the year.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealandâs nine Great Walks faster than theyâve ever been done before, using human power alone. Itâs the ultimate adventure race. Theyâll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Lüderitz"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring verkent de buurt weer en Cody gaat naar Lüderitz, Namibië, en verlaat daat de gebaande paden, helemaal door de woestijn heen, om naar spookstad Pamona te gaan.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Local Exploring in Tokio is compleet anders dan anders. Josh en Lexi Limitless bezoeken de drukke straten, een schreeuwend Monster Café en een verlaten 'liefdeshotel'.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nikko"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local is terug in Japan, in Nikko, waar Cody weer samenkomt met Sherman Mak en samen bezoeken zij een verlaten wrak en attractiepark genaamd Western Village.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Desert Survival"
programme.desc: Ash trekt de woestijn in om Wu Xinlei te ontmoeten, een survival-expert. Hij wil begrijpen hoe het voor de mensen moet zijn geweest die de Chinese Muur in dit afgelegen en onverbiddelijke landschap bouwden.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Crescent Lake"
programme.desc: Ash bevindt zich in de laatste etappe van zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur. Nadat hij de bouwtechnieken van de Muur heeft bestudeerd, trekt hij verder de Gobiwoestijn in, naar het betoverende Crescent Lake – een prachtige oase tussen zandduinen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Mission Accomplished"
programme.desc: Na een weerzien met een oude vriend van de Chu-muur bezoekt Ash enkele indrukwekkende stenen structuren – zowel natuurlijke als door mensenhanden gemaakt – in het Yardang Nationaal Park en in Xiaofang City. Met een laatste telefoontje naar huis komt er een einde aan zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Southern Tip of Africa"
programme.desc: Op het zuidelijkste puntje van Afrika ontmoet Xander een oude vriend om het unieke landschap van een kustplaats te verkennen en te genieten van de vele aangeboden faciliteiten.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Riding Waves in Stilbaai"
programme.desc: In Stilbaai nemen Xander en zijn team deel aan een sjamanistisch ritueel voordat ze aan een intimiderend avontuur beginnen. In Canada leert Adam een lesje over zelfbeheersing.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Mosselbay to Pinnacle Point"
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en z'n team van Mosselbaai naar Pinnacle Point reizen, hebben ze het naar hun zin bij een prachtig ziplineparcours, de beste golfbaan van Zuid-Afrika en tijdens een echte spadag.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Semi Final"
programme.desc: Vier teams nemen het tegen elkaar op in de halve finale. Eerst bereiden ze een zeevruchtenfestijn om indruk te maken op de beroemde chef Tom Hishon (Kingi, Orphans Kitchen, Daily Bread). Daarna koken de twee laagst scorende teams om hun plek in de finale te veroveren in de ultieme test van eenvoud: het perfecte stuk steak voor een verrassingsjurylid. Wie haalt de finale?

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Newfoundland & Labrador, Canada"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar de uiterste oostelijke rand van Noord-Amerika om de schoonheid van Newfoundland te ontdekken en de indrukwekkende East Coast Trail te verkennen.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "New South Wales, Australia"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Australië en zet zijn overlevingsvaardigheden op de ultieme proef terwijl hij ruige bergpaden trotseert tijdens extreem slecht weer in New South Wales.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Hong Kong: Mixology"
programme.desc: Sashi is terug in Hongkong om opnieuw een kijkje te nemen in verschillende facetten van de stad. Hij verkent de Taiwanese theecultuur, eet een kom rundvleesnoedels in het beroemdste restaurant van de stad en gaat vervolgens naar de beroemde bar- en mixologiescene van Hongkong.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert"
programme.sub-title: Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert
programme.desc: Sashi doet iets wat hij nog nooit eerder heeft gedaan! Een aflevering in lay-over-stijl. Hij heeft slechts 24 uur in de woestijnmetropool Dubai. Nadat hij de drukte van de menselijke activiteit in de bruisende souks van Dubai heeft opgezocht, doet Sashi het tegenovergestelde door de woestijn in te trekken.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Montenegro"
programme.desc: Jonathan fietst door Montenegro, verkent verborgen bunkers en Tito’s landgoed, bezoekt de baai van Kotor, proeft lokale gerechten en gaat mee met een bergreddingspatrouille.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Gratitude"
programme.desc: Op de laatste etappe van hun wereldwijde avontuur van 40K kilometer reizen Leon en Kindness One® langs de kust van de Stille Oceaan op weg naar Hollywood. Leon denkt terug aan zijn favoriete momenten, en inspireren hem om nogmaals af te spreken met de eerste persoon die hem vriendelijkheid toonde.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Faith"
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness 2 verlaten het zonnige Los Angeles en gaan naar het ijskoude Alaska. Ze zitten zonder geld of voedsel, maar een Canadese survivalist schiet te hulp.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Community"
programme.desc: Leon crasht en strandt op de ijzige wegen van Yukon. Hij wordt uitgenodigd op een feestje waar een man zijn huis openstelt voor talloze vluchtelingen.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Final"
programme.desc: De drie finalisten strijden in twee rondes. Eerst een live fire-uitdaging waarbij ze een volledig lam Asado-stijl moeten bereiden, gevolgd door een barbecue-degustatie om indruk te maken op de legendarische chef-kok Al Brown.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De eilandstaat met 7.000 eilanden heeft geen gebrek aan strand, zon of zee – maar kampt met een hardnekkig imagoprobleem als het om de keuken gaat. Jonathan landt in Manila en ontdekt al snel dat de topchefs zich maar al te goed bewust zijn van dit probleem. Op hun advies vertrekt hij op expeditie om een deel van de oplossing te vinden. De reis voert hem van dorpen van voormalige koppensnellers, via koloniale stadjes waar de tijd heeft stilgestaan, tot restaurants in de schaduw van het Amerikaanse militaire machtsblok. Gaandeweg ontvouwt zich een intrigerend verhaal. In de dichte jungle blijft het ene geheim begraven, terwijl het andere letterlijk uit het houtwerk tevoorschijn komt. Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "California"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trekt zijn wandelschoenen aan om enkele van Californië’s meest iconische natuurgebieden te verkennen, waaronder Yosemite National Park, de Mojavewoestijn en Butte County.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Poland"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Polen om de adembenemende wandelpaden van het Tatra- en Pieninygebergte te verkennen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Estonia / Vietnam"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering reist Josh samen met urban explorer Steve Duncan naar Tallinn in Estland, waar zij Patarei Prison verkennen. Intussen is Cody in Vietnam met zijn vriend Sherman Mak en reist naar Pan Thiet om op zoek te gaan naar verlaten attractiepark Soui Cat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Germany / Morocco"
programme.desc: Deze keer bezoeken urban explorers Josh en Cody afzonderlijk van elkaar Duitsland en Marokko en gaan op zoek naar prachtige, verlaten locaties, zoals Wünsdorf, de verboden stad in de buurt van Berlijn, en een verlaten filmset in de Sahara-woestijn die gebruikt is voor Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Purpose"
programme.desc: Na motorpech in Montana verblijft Leon in een besneeuwd wonderland. In Salt Lake City zorgt de passie van een vrouw om anderen te helpen voor inspiratie voor Leon's volgende geschenk.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Home"
programme.desc: Leon scheert zich glad en speelt cowboy op het platteland van Utah. Hij bezoekt de grens tussen de VS en Mexico en vindt hulp bij een lieve Mexicaanse familie.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Australia Top to Bottom"
programme.desc: Australië is een reusachtig land met diverse ecosystemen die het tot een van de interessantste ter wereld maken. Deze aflevering van Travel Quest verkent het noorden en het verre zuiden van dit land... het grootste “eiland” ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Polar Bears"
programme.desc: Er is één plek ter wereld waar de machtige ijsbeer - de grootste carnivoor ter wereld - in grote aantallen te vinden is gedurende een zeer specifieke periode van het jaar... Churchill Manitoba, Canada.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Lüderitz"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring verkent de buurt weer en Cody gaat naar Lüderitz, Namibië, en verlaat daat de gebaande paden, helemaal door de woestijn heen, om naar spookstad Pamona te gaan.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Foraging In Bali"
programme.desc: Sashi verkent de verborgen kant van het beroemde paradijselijke eiland Bali. Zijn gids en mentor voor deze aflevering is chef-kok Reynaldo de Luna. Samen zijn ze op zoek gegaan naar de biodiversiteit en verborgen schatten die Bali te bieden heeft!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Hong Kong: Mixology"
programme.desc: Sashi is terug in Hongkong om opnieuw een kijkje te nemen in verschillende facetten van de stad. Hij verkent de Taiwanese theecultuur, eet een kom rundvleesnoedels in het beroemdste restaurant van de stad en gaat vervolgens naar de beroemde bar- en mixologiescene van Hongkong.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert"
programme.sub-title: Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert
programme.desc: Sashi doet iets wat hij nog nooit eerder heeft gedaan! Een aflevering in lay-over-stijl. Hij heeft slechts 24 uur in de woestijnmetropool Dubai. Nadat hij de drukte van de menselijke activiteit in de bruisende souks van Dubai heeft opgezocht, doet Sashi het tegenovergestelde door de woestijn in te trekken.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "US Virgin Islands"
programme.desc: De Amerikaanse Maagdeneilanden behoren tot de populairste bestemmingen in het Caribisch gebied — maar hoe zit het met hun keuken? Met een robuuste 4x4-jeep verkent Sashi de eilandengroep en ontdekt hij verhalen over lokale gerechten, nieuwe distilleerderijen en nog veel meer.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "French Polynesia Part 1"
programme.desc: Sashi bevindt zich op een afgelegen eilandengroep midden in de oceaan: Frans-Polynesië! Op het eiland Bora Bora zoekt hij naar een authentieke lokale maaltijd — tevergeefs. Daarom schakelt hij over naar plan B: een bezoek aan het legendarische Four Seasons Bora Bora, waar hij met lokale vissers op diepzeevistocht gaat en een yellowtail-tuna vangt.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Vietnam"
programme.desc: Jonathan rijdt van Hanoi naar Ho Chi Minh en ontdekt verborgen bunkers, verhalen over rebellen, zeldzame vechtkunsten, oude ruïnes en alledaagse helden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Het is de geboorteplaats van Halloween, maar de geesten en griezels die de wereld hebben doorkruist, hebben weinig belangstelling gewekt voor de Ierse keuken. Jonathan stapt op een klassieke motor en doorkruist een land vol mystieke tradities, uitbundige locals en iconische landschappen. ’s Werelds meest onweerstaanbare pubcultuur trekt hem aan, grensconflicten drijven hem weg en duistere legendes lokken hem verder. Een avontuur doordrenkt van regen, sagen en het eten van voorouders uit vervlogen tijden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Jonathan staat voor zijn grootste uitdaging tot nu toe wanneer hij een land betreedt dat nog altijd worstelt met het definiëren en begrijpen van zijn eigen keuken. Door historische onrust en een streng klimaat is Rusland zijn traditionele kook- en eetcultuur grotendeels kwijtgeraakt. Maar het land blaast deze culinaire traditie nieuw leven in. Jonathan reist naar de uithoeken van Rusland om te leren van moderne chefs en oude keukens waarin het belangrijkste werktuig van de Russische keuken te vinden is: de Russische oven. Hij zal hun inzichten ontdekken, hun inspanningen begrijpen en werken met traditionele Russische ingrediënten om te leren wat de keuken vroeger was en waar het vandaag de dag naartoe gaat.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Jonathan staat voor zijn grootste uitdaging tot nu toe wanneer hij een land betreedt dat nog altijd worstelt met het definiëren en begrijpen van zijn eigen keuken. programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg komt uit Californië en denkt dat hij de Mexicaanse keuken wel kent. Maar die illusie spat uiteen zodra hij de overvloed aan eten in Mexico-Stad ervaart. Terwijl hij schorpioen-taco’s proeft en louche markten in San Juan ontwijkt, leert hij over de mysterieuze wereld van heilige dranken zoals pulque en mezcal, die inmiddels tot sociale genotsmiddelen zijn getransformeerd. Zijn reis voert hem ook naar Oaxaca, waar hij de geheimen van de legendarische molesaus ontdekt. Een lange tocht naar een afgelegen dorp onthult een geheime ceremonie met wortels in de duistere kunsten!

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Revelstoke"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent de indrukwekkende wandelroutes rond een van de meest avontuurlijke bergstadjes van Noord-Amerika: Revelstoke, British Columbia.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Dominica"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar het tropische paradijs Dominica om de langste wandelroute van het Caribisch gebied te verkennen en de spanning van freediven en canyoning te beleven.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Estes Park, Colorado"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson ontdekt de geweldige wandel- en klimavonturen in het koele bergstadje Estes Park, Colorado.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Food"

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Turtles"
programme.desc: 27 species of turtles today are on the very brink of becoming extinct, with over 240 additional species being threatened or critically endangered.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Amazon Anaconda"
programme.desc: Putting everything on the line, the hunters head to Peru where they go off-road and off the map in search of the mighty green anaconda. Shawn has spent more than a decade exploring the jungles of Peru, buying land, and building a home away from home.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Stalking the Anaconda"

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "The Birds"

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Primates"
programme.desc: In this episode Adrian, the zoo vet, treats Lesser White monkey with a weight issue. The zoo's three chimpanzees have their annual health check and Adrian becomes concerned that the eldest female is showing signs of ill health.

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Antarctic Adventure"

programme.desc: Explore a fascinating mix of animals from both land and sea! Discover why the seahorse moves like an underwater hummingbird, and learn how the Thomson’s gazelle can outmaneuver a cheetah in a race for survival.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Summer"
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Autumn"
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep, and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Animal Society S1 - "Fish"
programme.desc: All fish have moveable jaws and are covered in scales, using gills to breath underwater. Many forming schools or shoals based on social structure, it’s a unique group arrangement with many benefits.

programme.title: Animal Society S1 - "Bugs"
programme.desc: Invertebrates include all forms of insects, spiders, scorpions, centipedes and crustations, with nearly 10 million species. In this episode we take a closer look at the survival structure of bees, ants and spiders.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "MELEE AND BRAWL"

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "MASTERS OF DISGUISE"

programme.desc: Resources are tight in space. Everything that goes up there has mass and therefore a cost.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "World Wide Wifi"

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Strange Space Recipes"
programme.desc: Survival anywhere requires that we adapt to our surroundings but how will humans adapt to survive in space?

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Risk Taking, Money Making"
programme.desc: Torie and Larry duke it out on the auction floor for an incredible artefact. Cole meets astronaut Scott Parazynski who risked his life on one of the most daring spacewalks ever.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Risk Taking, Money Making"

programme.sub-title: Sol Ownership: Can A Corporation Own The Sun?

programme.desc: COLD WAR & THE START OF THE SPACE RACE – Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. SERVICING HUBBLE - Preparations for Hubble’s final servicing mission. CHASING A COMET - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Mars Express"
programme.desc: PROJECT MERCURY BEGINS - The start of NASA & America’s first manned space program. MARS EXPRESS - The European Space Agency’s Mars Satellite. THE SOYUZ LAUNCH SYSTEM - The gradual evolution of Russia’s Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Mercury Advances"
programme.desc: PROJECT MERCURY ADVANCES - America’s first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. CAMERA TRACKING - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Venus Express"
programme.desc: PROJECT GEMINI COMMENCES - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? VENUS EXPRESS - The last days of ESA’s Venus probe. EMU NASA’s - Extravehicular Mobility Unit. DEEP SPACE COMMUNICATIONS - ESA’s worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Dark Side"
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars"
programme.sub-title: Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars
programme.desc: With NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, how long until some giant corporation turns moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 1)"
programme.sub-title: Day in the life of an air show (Part 1)
programme.desc: We take you behind the scenes for an exclusive look at the inner workings of one of America’s biggest air shows.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )"
programme.sub-title: Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to the two-part special including an up-close look at the U.S. Navy Blue Angels.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programme.desc: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive flyer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programme.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "First Images: The James Webb Telescope"
programme.sub-title: First Images: The James Webb Telescope
programme.desc: The dawn of a new era in astronomy has begun as the world gets its first look at the full capabilities of NASA's James Webb Telescope. There first images from the world's largest and most powerful space telescope demonstrate Webb at its full power.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Artemis: First Launch"
programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Year of the Asteroid"
programme.desc: New breakthroughs in extra-planetary surveying and rocket propulsion are revealing the dichotomy of asteroids.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Reefs of Hope"
programme.desc: With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Pay Terry Back"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test 2 scenes from Mel Gibson’s film Payback. Mel's character is in the back of a taxi when 4 bad guys pull up next to him in an SUV, they open fire and Mel uses a bad guy in the cab as a shield.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Paint Your Red River Stagecoach at High Noon"
programme.sub-title: Paint Your Red River Stagecoach at High Noon
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will test different famous shots from westerns. Can you shoot a cowboy hat off the bad guy? Will a shotgun blast really throw you back through a window? Can a single shot from a colt revolver break shackles?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Underworld"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry are going to test a famous scene from Underworld with Kate Beckensale. Terry will attempt to shoot a circle around himself in the floor and fall through to save himself from the pack of werewolves.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "A Pirates Life for Terry"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry go on a swashbuckling adventure when they test two scenes from the 1920’s film, The Black Pirate starring Douglas Fairbanks, Senior. Terry will see if he can knock down a ships mast with a canon, and then test gravity as he slides down a sail with only a knife.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Phantoms"
programme.desc: What is the Body Transfer Illusion or the Moon Illusion? We also explain how the Autokinetic Effect and the Stereoscopy work!

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Art of illusion"
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed? What does it mean to see a Mirage? And when we see a spinning dancer why one can either perceive as spinning clockwise or counter clockwise?

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Phenomenal"
programme.desc: In this episode we learn the diference between Iridescence, Chemiluminescence and Bioluminescence. We also learn about Gemstone Coloration and Mechanical Plant Defenses.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Sensory Tricks"
programme.desc: In the last episode of the season we'll learn about sensory tricks - visually-evoked auditory response, retinal fatigue, Müller-Lyer illusion, Ames room and synesthesia.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Hidden Marvels"
programme.desc: This episode explores some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Ancient Waterways"
programme.desc: The ancient ancestors realized that building structures and machines to harness water to provide transport, power, drainage and irrigation was vital to the success of their civilizations.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Building Bridges"
programme.desc: Our ancient ancestors had to come up with ingenious solutions and structures to travel freely - over the hills, valleys and rivers of our world.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Okichitaw - Meegwun Fairbrother"
programme.desc: Canadian actor Meegwun Fairbrother overcame his substance abuse trough Okichitaw, a native American martial art using the gunstock war club and the tomahawk.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Phantom Limb"
programme.desc: Jack joins amputees trying to find out why they feel sensations in their missing limbs.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Seeing is Believing"
programme.desc: Jack meets a man who has bizarre hallucinations and witnesses cutting edge surgery.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Time"
programme.desc: Jack meets a woman who has lost all sense of time and reveals how time can be elastic.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Marble"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel through India searching for a rock that is converted by heat pressure within the earth to become what we call marble.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Meteorites"
programme.desc: In this episode we go back in time to the edge of a 50.000-year crater. On a highway to Arizona, we followed the sign 'Meteor Crater'. This was the start for a fantastic tour to rocks from another world.

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Antarctic Adventure"
programme.desc: Blue World travels to Antarctica on an epic adventure where we swim with penguins, meet a Leopard Seal, and dive under icebergs.

programme.title: Blue World S3 - "Blue Holes and the Georgia Aquarium"
programme.sub-title: Blue Holes and the Georgia Aquarium
programme.desc: Blue World travels to the Bahamas to explore a deep blue hole, then visits the Georgia Aquarium to study Whale sharks who live in a giant tank.

programme.title: Blue World S3 - "Groupers, Coral and Camouflage"
programme.desc: Blue World investigates a huge grouper that’s making a comeback in Florida, visits Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, and studies camouflage in sea creatures.

programme.desc: A sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns deadly…for him.

programme.desc: John Savage, Treat Williams, Beverly D'Angelo star in this adaptation of the hit Broadway musical phenomenon.

programme.desc: When a star coach is murdered and his Pink Panther diamond stolen, Clouseau is on the case!

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: Steve Martin returns to the scene of the fun as the bumbling Inspector Jacques Clouseau!

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Seven gunslingers face an army of marauding bandits in this classic starring Yul Brynner and Steve McQueen.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Seven gunslingers face an army of marauding bandits in this classic starring Yul Brynner and Steve McQueen.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name devises a plan to destroy the criminals who are terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: The Man With No Name goes up against a lethal gunman as they both pursue a killer and his gang.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Ugly
programme.desc: The Man With No Name is back and in lethal pursuit of $200,000 in Confederate money.

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Rock-A-Doodle
programme.desc: A rooster loses his status in the barnyard and heads off to Las Vegas for fame and fortune!

programme.title: The Secret Of Nimh
programme.desc: To save her family from a farmer’s plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!

programme.title: All Dogs Go To Heaven (1989)
programme.desc: A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.

programme.title: All Dogs Go To Heaven 2
programme.desc: Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.

programme.title: Eight Men Out
programme.desc: The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: 10 To Midnight
programme.desc: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Messenger Of Death
programme.desc: Charles Bronson travels to a Colorado to investigate and finds a plot of greed and religious zealotry.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Inspired by Oliver Stone's own experiences, this anti-war epic tells the tale of PFC Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen), an Army recruit sent to Vietnam, who witnesses the atrocities of war – many of which are carried out by his comrades.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: Eye Of The Needle
programme.desc: Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an "inescapable" Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

When it's traced back to him, Dale and Saul run for their lives and they quickly discover that they're not just suffering from weed-fueled paranoia. If they survive, these two just might become real friends.

programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.
